newsitem.title: USA: EU to coordinate Boeing analysis with US.
newsitem.headline: EU to coordinate Boeing analysis with US.

text.p: A key European Union competition official said Thursday he would "do everything" to reach the same analysis as the U.S. about problems with the Boeing Co merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp.

"We will do everything to come to identical views with American authorities on objections to the deal and once we have reached this, then we will look into possible remedies," said Alexander Schaub, director-general for competition of the European Commission. And I believe they (the Americans) will do everything also to avoid contradictory conclusions," he told reporters, after speaking to the European Institute.

Schaub, the number two man in the EU competition authority, is in the United States for a regular bilateral meeting with American competition authorities. He meets Friday with the Federal Trade Commission, the American antitrust authority considering the proposed aerospace merger.

Schaub said it was "theoretically possible" the EU and U.S. could reach different but uncontradictory conclusions about the deal, "if the problems in the European market are not the same as the American market." But he said it was too soon to know if that were true.

"We haven't yet discussed this," he said. "I would be rather ludicrous if I were to say today they are the same or they are not the same, without having discussed it in any detail with my American colleagues."
